name: demo-playwright-typescript
summary: A beginner walkthrough demonstrating Playwright locator strategies and form interactions in TypeScript against https://testingexamples.github.io/en-001/practice/.
description: Demonstrates locating elements by id, name attribute, class, link text, and XPath, then filling a text input, checking a checkbox, checking a radio button, and selecting a dropdown option, using Playwright (Chromium) with TypeScript.
